title: 3 Things to Know Before Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle’s Next Movie
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Demon Slayer manga! While the animation studio remains silent on any updates regarding the second installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy, the first part is all set for its global streaming date.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia’s New Anime Delivers the True Finale Fans Deserved
content: My Hero Academia is one of the most successful Shonen anime and manga series of all time. Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, the manga reached its conclusion on August 5th, 2024, after a decade of serialization.
author: ComicBook

title: Shingo Natsume, Madhouse's ghost – end of night Original Anime Film Unveils Teaser, Cast
content: The official website for ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, unveiled a new teaser trailer for the anime film on Friday. The teaser reveals the film's two lead cast members.
author: ANN

title: 6 Years Later, Haikyu Confirms a Brand New Release For Fans Ahead of Anime’s Return
content: Written and illustrated by Haruichi Furudate, Haikyu!! remains one of the most beloved Weekly Shonen Jump series of all time. The manga debuted in 2012 and reached its conclusion in 2020, after years of serialization.
author: ComicBook

title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi Anime Film Unveils Trailer, Cast, Theme Song
content: The staff of Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film trilogy , unveiled on Friday a new trailer and cast members. The video reveals and previews the theme song "Chain of the Abyss" by the series' composer Kevin Penkin feat. Mori Calliope .
author: ANN

title: 'Ghost: Yoru no Hate' Reveals Main Cast Pair, Third Teaser Trailer
content: The official website for the Ghost: Yoru no Hate original anime movie revealed the main cast and a third teaser trailer on Friday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on February 11, 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: My Hero Academia Just Doubled Down on the Anime’s Smartest Bakugo Decision
content: My Hero Academia ‘s main story ended back in December, but the anime has been dragging out its farewell. Since Season 8’s conclusion, it’s delivered a special episode highlighting the characters’ lives after U.A. High , along with a six-minute catch-up focused on Eri’s time at school.
author: ComicBook

title: Shingo Natsume's Original Anime Film ghost Reveals Main Cast in First Teaser
content: Shingo Natsume’s first original feature-length anime film, ghost – end of night , has revealed its main cast in a new teaser trailer. Mayu Hotta stars as Nike, a 15-year-old girl who has already been “selected” in a society where people are judged at the age of 18 on whether they are needed by the world.
author: Anime Corner

title: Every Crunchyroll Anime of the Year Champion Since the Awards Began
content: Crunchyroll Anime Awards have become one of anime’s biggest annual events, with fan voting serving as the primary factor in determining the winners. The Anime Awards began in 2017, and over the past decade, Crunchyroll has held ten ceremonies, with fans selecting ten Anime of the Year winners.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Reasons Solo Leveling Became So Popular (#1 Is What Most Fans Won’t Admit)
content: Solo Leveling has emerged as one of the most popular anime of the modern generation. The scale of its success is truly remarkable, as proven by its sweep of the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2025 with its first season.
